title: Neural Inside — Actual Gameplay | Looking for Feedback
author: Welfero
selftext:
This video shows actual gameplay and in-game features from Neural Inside.

I’d love to hear what feels lacking and what you think could be improved.

comments.author: After-Injury5631
comments.body: It looks like a nice light novel. Well done! If anything, the music makes me sleepy and might shorten my gameplay sessions because I'm so relaxed. Also, I couldn't really get a gist of what's going on during the gameplay loop; it looks like an investigation of sorts, but without deeper context it doesn't make sense.

replies.author: Welfero
replies.body:
Thank you.

I’ll work on improving the background music. The core gameplay loop involves gathering clues, analyzing them, and then selecting dialogue options based on that analysis. I’ll also try to prepare a video to help make the mechanics easier to understand.
